messages:
Priya: Quick sync — Analytics MVP scope decision needed. Customer A asked for per-user retention export but eng says that export will add ~2 sprints. Options: push export to v1, cut dashboard filters, or extend milestone. Need alignment by EOD.
Devin: +1 to defer export to v1. Exports touch ETL and infra.
Tom: Cutting advanced filters from MVP would reduce work surface a lot. Basic filters + core dashboard keeps value.
Maya: FYI Customer A is on a pilot; they'd be OK with v1 if we give a clear ETA and a short-term workaround (CSV via API).
Mike: Infra note — export requires new recurring job + S3 policy + ACL review. Rough estimate: 3w dev + 1w infra ops. Not safe for current milestone.
Priya: Sounds like consensus forming. Proposal: cut export from MVP, commit to v1 within 6 weeks. We keep core dashboard and basic filters in MVP.
Ellen: I can own the comms to pilot customers and update the public roadmap entry. I'll open the customer-facing note once we lock the decision.
Tom: I'll scope what "basic filters" means and drop a trimmed spec later today.
Priya: Assigning owners: eng -> Tom, infra/SRE -> Mike, comms -> Ellen. I'll own product acceptance criteria.
Priya: New launch criteria draft: 
```yaml
launch_criteria:
  - core_dashboard: done
  - basic_filters: done
  - export: deferred_to_v1
  - performance: p95 < 300ms for common queries
  - canary_users: >= 5 pilot teams
```
Devin: can we add a rollback/fallback plan if dashboard load spikes? maybe prefix caching + restrict export concurrency.
Mike: Agree. SRE will add a temporary circuit-breaker and throttle for exports in the v1 rollout plan.
Priya: Ellen, please post the user-facing note with ETA and workaround. Tom, update the ticket with the trimmed spec. I'll update the milestone tracker and notify leadership.
Ellen: Posted to pilot slack and updated the docs: https://redwood.docs/pilot/analytics-mvp (note: link placeholder). :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: milestone/analytics-mvp -> canary at 2023-11-02T17:00Z (auto).
Tom: Quick question — does deferring export affect pricing assumptions for MVP? need to flag to finance.
Priya: Good catch. I'll send a short note to finance with the changed unit economics.
Maya: Customer A replied: "OK to defer if we get ETA + API CSV workaround". Keeping them in the loop helps retention.
Priya: Closing decision: export deferred to v1 (target 6 weeks), MVP scope = core dashboard + basic filters + performance SLOs. We'll reconvene if any blocker emerges.
Devin: Thanks everyone.
Tom: Will upload trimmed spec by 5pm.
Ellen: I'll schedule the customer update.
Mike: I'll add the circuit-breaker playbook to the SRE runbook.
Priya: Great — action items noted. End of thread.
